faq.eyebrow: A FEW THINGS YOU MIGHT BE WONDERING
faq.title: Good questions.

items.question: What is available today?
items.answer: The multipage website and interactive workspace screens are available. Explore rooms, tasks, agent roles, artifacts and approval interactions. Workspace changes stay in the current browser tab.

items.question: How do agents connect?
items.answer: Agent execution follows the published engineering roadmap. The current website does not connect provider accounts or run code. The planned adapters keep runtime, permissions and model providers separate.

items.question: Who is SynqHarbor being built for?
items.answer: Small software and automation agencies, developers working with clients, operations teams, and creative teams who want people and agents to work from the same context.

items.question: Can I host the platform myself?
items.answer: Yes. The current website builds to static files and can be hosted on your own infrastructure. The self-hosting guide explains installation, configuration, upgrades and rollback. The authenticated platform follows the roadmap.

items.question: Does approving a result publish anything?
items.answer: Approvals in the current workspace update browser-tab state. The future backend must bind authorization to exact artifact versions and separate client content approval from developer release authority.
